title: 第5章 入宗门上第6章 入宗门下
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
经过短短五天的愉快旅程，灵船终于抵达了天玄宗山脚下。
这五天对于宁知初来说，那可真是充实又有趣。
她时不时就去找于师姐唠唠嗑，顺便向她讨教一些修仙界的小常识。
两人那叫一个相谈甚欢，越聊越投缘，宁知初也从中学到了不少好东西呢。
当灵船慢悠悠地靠岸，宁知初和其他人一起地走下灵船，到了一处山门前。
山门宏伟壮观，让人感觉严肃庄重。
山门里面是一条长长的台阶，一眼都看不到头，这就是天玄宗新弟子测心性的天梯！
台阶上方云雾飘飘的，就跟仙境似的，美极了！
山门下聚集了好多好多人，他们都和宁知初一样，是测完灵根后被带到这儿来的新弟子。
每个人的脸上都写满了兴奋和期待，毕竟能成为天玄宗的弟子，那可是好多人做梦都想的美事呢。
宁知初站在人群里，眨巴着大眼睛，好奇地东张西望。
她看到有些新弟子在叽叽喳喳地聊天，有些则在偷偷打量着这座神秘的山门。
而她自己，则默默的听着他们谈话内容。
听说这次天梯有九百九十九阶呢！
我爹说爬到一半会有幻境考验...
怕什么，我带了清心符！
周围的孩童们叽叽喳喳地讨论着，宁知初安静地站在人群边缘，手指无意识地卷着衣角。
她今天穿了一身洗得发白的青色布衣，头发用红绳简单扎成马尾，在晨风中轻轻晃动。
巳时已到，登天梯开始！
外门长老的声音如同洪钟，在山门前回荡。

话音未落，人群就像炸开的蜂群，争先恐后地涌向那蜿蜒入云的石阶。
宁知初不急不躁，等大部分人都冲上去后，才迈开步子。
她数着自己的呼吸，左脚、右脚，一步一个台阶，节奏稳得像在平地上散步。
石阶两旁是郁郁葱葱的松柏，阳光透过树叶在地上投下斑驳的光影。
渐渐地，前面的脚步声和说话声都消失了，宁知初抬头望去，长长的天梯上只剩下她一个人。
看来是进入独立空间了。
她自言自语，继续保持着匀速前进。
忽然，一阵乳白色的雾气从四面八方涌来，转眼间就淹没了整条石阶。
宁知初停下脚步，好奇地伸手触碰那些雾气，指尖传来微微的凉意。
这就是幻境入口吧？她不仅不害怕，反而有些期待地向前迈了一步。
眼前的景象骤然变化。
她站在一个金碧辉煌的房间中央，地上堆满了...人民币？
这...宁知初瞪大眼睛，蹲下身拿起一沓百元大钞。
纸张的触感无比真实，甚至能闻到油墨的味道。
她忍不住笑出声：我都穿越到修仙了，幻境怎么还给我看这个？
仿佛回应她的想法，满屋子的人民币突然闪烁了一下，变成了一座座晶莹剔透的灵石山。
上品灵石散发着柔和的灵光，中品灵石堆成小山，角落里还有几颗罕见的极品灵石，像星星一样闪烁。
宁知初的呼吸不自觉地急促起来。
她伸手摸了摸最近的一块上品灵石，冰凉的触感从指尖传来。
content_en:
After just five days of pleasant journey, the spirit boat finally arrived at the foot of Tianxuanzong Mountain.
These five days were really fulfilling and interesting for Ning Zhichu.
From time to time, she went to chat with Senior Sister Yu and asked her for some tips on the world of immortality.
The two of them chatted happily, and the more they chatted, the closer they got to each other. Ning Zhichu also learned a lot of good things from them.
When the spirit boat slowly docked, Ning Zhichu and others stepped off the spirit boat and arrived in front of a mountain gate.
The mountain gate is majestic and majestic, making people feel solemn and solemn.
Inside the mountain gate is a long staircase with no end at all. This is the ladder for new Tianxuan Sect disciples to test their xinxing!
The clouds and mist above the steps are floating, just like a fairyland, so beautiful!
Many people gathered under the mountain gate. Like Ning Zhichu, they were all new disciples who were brought here after testing their spiritual roots.
Everyone's face was filled with excitement and expectation. After all, being able to become a disciple of Tianxuan Sect was a wonderful thing that many people only dreamed of.
Ning Zhichu stood in the crowd, blinking his big eyes and looking around curiously.
She saw some new disciples chatting, while others were secretly looking at this mysterious mountain gate.
As for herself, she listened to their conversation silently.
I heard that this ladder has 999 steps!
My dad said there will be a fantasy test halfway up the climb...
What are you afraid of? I brought the Pure Heart Talisman!
The children around were chattering and discussing. Ning Zhichu stood quietly on the edge of the crowd, his fingers curling up the corners of his clothes unconsciously.
Today she wore a blue cloth that had been washed white, and her hair was simply tied into a ponytail with a red rope, swaying gently in the morning breeze.
It’s time to climb the ladder to heaven!
The voice of the outer sect elder was like a loud bell, echoing in front of the mountain gate.
Before he finished speaking, the crowd was like an exploding swarm of bees, rushing towards the stone steps that snaked into the clouds.
Ning Zhichu was not impatient and waited until most of the people rushed forward before taking a step forward.
She counted her breaths, left foot, right foot, step by step, the rhythm was as steady as walking on flat ground.
The stone steps are lined with lush pines and cypresses, and the sun shines through the leaves and casts mottled light and shadow on the ground.
Gradually, the footsteps and voices in front disappeared. Ning Zhichu looked up and saw that she was the only one left on the long ladder.
It seems that we have entered an independent space.
She muttered to herself and continued to move forward at a steady pace.
Suddenly, a burst of milky white mist came from all directions, submerging the entire stone steps in the blink of an eye.
Ning Zhichu stopped and curiously stretched out his hand to touch the mist, feeling a slight coolness on his fingertips.
Is this the entrance to the fantasy world? Not only was she not afraid, but she took a step forward with some anticipation.
The scene in front of me suddenly changed.
She stood in the middle of a splendid room, with piles of... RMB on the floor?
This... Ning Zhichu's eyes widened, and he knelt down and picked up a wad of hundred-yuan bills.
The feel of the paper is so real that you can even smell the ink.
She couldn't help but laugh out loud: I have traveled through time to cultivate immortality, why are you still showing me this in the fantasy world?
As if responding to her thoughts, the RMB in the room suddenly flashed and turned into crystal clear mountains of spiritual stone.
The high-grade spiritual stones exude a soft spiritual light, the middle-grade spiritual stones are piled into a hill, and there are a few rare top-grade spiritual stones in the corners, twinkling like stars.
Ning Zhichu's breathing quickened unconsciously.
She reached out and touched the nearest high-grade spiritual stone, and a cold touch came from her fingertips.
